printf 'safe_reboot_command='; command -v openrc-shutdown
printf 'current_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

printf 'reboot='; command -v reboot || true
printf 'poweroff='; command -v poweroff || true
printf 'shutdown='; command -v shutdown || true
printf 'openrc_candidates:\n'; ls /sbin /usr/sbin 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(openrc-shutdown|reboot|shutdown)$' || true
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

set -eu
before_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
nohup sh -c 'sleep 3; exec /sbin/reboot' </dev/null >/tmp/redis-benchmark-reboot.log 2>&1 &
restart_pid=$!
printf 'restart_acknowledged node=%s mechanism=/sbin/reboot pid=%s before_boot_id=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$restart_pid" "$before_boot_id"
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'reachable boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service='; rc-service redis status
printf 'managed_ip=%s\n' "$NODE_IP"

set -eu
before_boot_id='ca0d8525-ef93-45d3-bc24-9f5578837245'
after_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$after_boot_id" != "$before_boot_id" ]
. /etc/redis-inventory.env
[ "$REDIS_HOST" = "$NODE_IP" ]
redis_cmd() { REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD" redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" --no-auth-warning --raw "$@"; }
expected_value="inventory-persistent-$before_boot_id"
[ "$(redis_cmd PING)" = PONG ]
[ "$(redis_cmd ACL WHOAMI)" = inventory ]
[ "$(redis_cmd GET inventory:restart-proof)" = "$expected_value" ]
unauthenticated=$(redis-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --raw PING 2>&1 || true)
case "$unauthenticated" in *NOAUTH*) : ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
inventory_hash=$(printf '%s' "$REDIS_PASSWORD" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
grep -q "user inventory on #$inventory_hash " /etc/redis/users.acl
printf 'before_boot_id=%s\n' "$before_boot_id"
printf 'after_boot_id=%s\n' "$after_boot_id"
printf 'boot_identity_changed=yes\n'
printf 'service='; rc-service redis status
printf 'enabled='; rc-update show default | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])redis([[:space:]]|$)'
printf 'listener:\n'; netstat -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep "$NODE_IP:6379"
printf 'unauthenticated_access=%s\n' "$unauthenticated"
printf 'authenticated_ping=%s\n' "$(redis_cmd PING)"
printf 'authenticated_identity=%s\n' "$(redis_cmd ACL WHOAMI)"
printf 'recovered_value=%s\n' "$(redis_cmd GET inventory:restart-proof)"
printf 'database_size=%s\n' "$(redis_cmd DBSIZE)"
printf 'runtime_persistence:\n'; redis_cmd CONFIG GET dir dbfilename appendonly appendfsync appenddirname
printf 'persistence_health:\n'; redis_cmd INFO persistence | tr -d '\r' | grep -E '^(loading|async_loading|rdb_last_bgsave_status|aof_enabled|aof_rewrite_in_progress|aof_last_write_status|aof_current_size|aof_base_size):'
printf 'credential_file='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/redis-inventory.env
printf 'acl_file='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/redis/users.acl
printf 'acl_credential_binding=verified-by-sha256\n'
printf 'disk_artifacts:\n'; find /var/lib/redis -maxdepth 2 -type f -exec stat -c '%U:%G %a %s %n' {} \; | sort
